p.i: antea fuerint. Quorum rex Eurotimus, fiducia septin-gentorum filiorum, quos ex pellicibus susceperat, diui-sis exercitibus nunc AEgyptum, nunc Syriam infesta-bat: magnumq; nomen Arabum, viribus finitimorum exsanguibus fecerat.

main_text.head: POMPEII TROGI EPI-TOMA HISTORIARVM 10
LIBER XL.
BREVIARIVM.
main_text.p: 1 Tigranem Armenium chus Cyziceni filius creatur Syri regem sibi deligunt. rexSyriæ,quæ postea in pro 15

2 Victo Tigrane, Antio- uinciæ formam redigitur. [illegible, ~1 letters]VTVIS fratrum odiis, & mox filiis inimicitiis parentum succedentibus, cum inexpiabili bello & reges, & regnum Syria consumptum esset, ad externa populus auxilia concurrit, peregrinosque sibi reges circumspicere coepit. Itaq; cum pars Mithridatem Ponticum, pars Ptolemaum ab AEgypto arcessendum censeret; occurreretque quod Mithridates implicitus bello Romano esset, Ptolemaus quoque semper hostis fuisset Syriae, omnes in Tigranem regem Armeniae consensere, instructum praeter domesticas vires, & Parthica societate & Mithridatis affinitate. Igitur accitus in regnum Syriae, per 18. annos tranquillissimo regno potitus est: neque bello alium lacessere, neque lacessitus inferre alii bellum necesse habuit.

page.notes: Two-column summary: the left column reads "1 Tigranem Armenium ... Syri regem sibi deligunt" and "2 Victo Tigrane, Antiochia ..."; the right column's second line is cut off at the end of this part. Printed text is continued on the other half of the page. Marginal numerals 10 and 15 and the § mark are reference marks; the "rexSyriæ,quæ postea in pro" line is a single run in the printed right-hand column. The first word is a large woodcut initial M, read as the initial of "MVTVIS"; the marginal note at the left ("Syria bellis fraternis & civilibus consumpta, externum regem, nempe Tigranem Armenium sibi deligit") is in the left margin, and line numbers 20, 25, 30 stand in the right margin. The first line may be partly from the initial and is uncertain.
